name: bookcovers-pro
description: Exact print cover sizes for self-published books on Amazon KDP, IngramSpark and Lulu: spine width, full wrap, bleed, barcode area, ebook and audiobook sizes.

interface.longDescription:
BookCovers.pro works out the exact print cover size for a self-published book, right in the chat.

Tell it your trim size, page count and paper, and it returns the figures each printer needs for Amazon KDP, IngramSpark and Lulu: the spine width, the full wrap width and height in inches, millimetres and pixels at 300 dpi, the bleed (or the board wrap for a case-laminate hardcover), the text-safe margin, whether the printer allows spine text at that page count, and the clear area to leave for the ISBN barcode. It also gives the ebook cover size and the 3000 x 3000 audiobook square.

The spine is different at each printer, which is why one cover file rarely passes all three. BookCovers.pro uses the same calculations as its own cover designer: KDP's paper multipliers, Lightning Source's own per-paper spine table for IngramSpark, and Lulu's spine formula. The results card shows each printer side by side with a diagram of the wrap.

Each answer includes a link that opens the BookCovers.pro cover designer with the trim, page count and paper already filled in.

The app only calculates. It does not need an account, it does not see your manuscript, and it never changes anything.
defaultPrompt: What size is my KDP cover for a 6x9, 280-page book on cream paper?
What spine width do I need for IngramSpark, 5.5x8.5, 312 pages, white paper?
Give me the hardcover wrap size for my 481-page 6x9 book on KDP.

positive.prompt: What size is my KDP cover for a 6x9, 280-page book on cream paper?
positive.expected_behavior: A card shows Amazon KDP: full cover 12.95" x 9.25", spine 0.7" (17.8 mm), 3885 x 2775 px at 300 dpi, 0.125" bleed, spine text allowed, the 2.0 x 1.2 in barcode area, and the ebook (1600 x 2560) and audiobook (3000 x 3000) sizes. ChatGPT repeats these figures and offers the link to the designer.

positive.description: IngramSpark spine width from Lightning Source's table
positive.prompt: What spine width do I need for IngramSpark, 5.5x8.5, 312 pages, white paper?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers with an IngramSpark spine of 0.653" and a full cover of 11.903" x 8.75" (3571 x 2625 px at 300 dpi), noting the spine comes from Lightning Source's own per-paper table.

positive.prompt: Give me the hardcover wrap size for my 481-page 6x9 book on KDP, cream paper.
positive.expected_behavior: Answers with a KDP hardcover spine of 1.5485" and a full wrap of 14.9655" x 10.417", explaining that each edge carries 0.7085" of board wrap instead of the 0.125" paperback bleed.

positive.prompt: I'm printing an 8.5x11, 120-page premium colour book on Lulu. What pixel size should my full cover be at 300 dpi?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers 5275 x 3375 px for Lulu (17.5803" x 11.25", spine 0.3303"), with a note to confirm the spine against Lulu's own template because Lulu publishes paper thickness only for standard white paper.

positive.description: All three printers plus ebook and audiobook
positive.prompt: Compare the cover sizes for KDP, IngramSpark and Lulu for my 6x9, 200-page book on white paper, and tell me the ebook and audiobook cover sizes too.
positive.expected_behavior: The card shows three printers side by side: KDP spine 0.4504" (12.7004" x 9.25"), IngramSpark spine 0.424" (12.674" x 9.25"), Lulu spine 0.5105" (12.7605" x 9.25"), plus ebook 1600 x 2560 and audiobook 3000 x 3000.

publication.release_notes: First release: exact print cover sizes for Amazon KDP, IngramSpark and Lulu (spine, full wrap, bleed or hardcover wrap, safe margins, barcode area), plus ebook and audiobook cover sizes, with a link that opens the BookCovers.pro designer with the specs filled in.
